clues.text: This coaster climbs to a height of 52 feet, reaches a top speed of 35 mph, and features zero inversions.
Manufactured by Mack, this attraction welcomed its very first riders back in 2002.
You'll find this family coaster operating in the state of Virginia.
This Wild Mouse roller coaster delivers quick turns and drops to guests at Kings Dominion.
The ride features a playful, rhyming two-word name that pairs a common orchard fruit with an energetic, made-up word.

evidence.quote: Apple Zapple (formerly known as Ricochet) is a Wild Mouse roller coaster located at Kings Dominion in Doswell, Virginia.
